direct_ancestors.description: We aim to provide high resolution, high dimensional images of the maternal-fetal interface in the first 20 weeks of pregnancy. Each sample is comprised primarily of decidua basalis from archival FFPE tissue. Some samples also contain adjacent placental villi.

metadata.description: We aim to provide high resolution, high dimensional images of human placenta in early pregnancy by using our multiplexed ion beam imaging methodology for building an atlas of human organs
